items.t: Rattle or grinding on cold start from the camshaft adjusters
items.job: Replace camshaft adjusters; inspect or replace the timing chain and tensioner
items.note: Parts: FCP Euro lists a Febi camshaft adjuster kit for the GLC300 at about $989. No published labor time was found, so the hours are set to match Euro Premium Parts' independent-shop total of about $900–$2,100. One owner was quoted about $6,000 at a dealer when the timing chain was included.

items.t: Oil leaking from the camshaft solenoids into the wiring
items.job: Replace leaking camshaft solenoid(s) and seals; add a harness protection kit if oil has reached the wiring
items.note: FCP Euro: camshaft solenoid about $49–$54, harness protection kit about $145 (confirm the part by VIN). RepairPal GLC300 valve timing solenoid replacement: $171–$436 total. Euro Premium Parts: about $150–$450. Labor hours are set from these totals. More if the wiring harness itself must be replaced.

items.t: Thermostat sticks open or leaks coolant
items.job: Replace thermostat assembly and refill coolant
items.note: ECS Tuning: thermostat assembly about $99 (Rein) to $224 (genuine Mercedes); check your option codes. No published labor time was found, so hours are set to match Euro Premium Parts' total of about $300–$600.
